## Scope

The audit covered 295 second reads undertaken during the quarter. The review examined the consistency of grading decisions across the material selected for audit. Each second read was compared with the original grading decision, with the results consolidated to provide an overall measure of agreement. The audit was intended to support routine quality monitoring and to identify any issues requiring further review or discussion.

## Result

Overall agreement was 67.5 per cent. This result provides a summary measure for the audited second reads and should be considered alongside the individual grading patterns identified during the review. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet. These results will be discussed privately with each grader to support feedback, clarify any areas of difference, and identify opportunities for consistent application of the grading approach. The spreadsheet should be used as the detailed record supporting the overall result reported above.
